candidates.reason: Only test module in the repository that imports and drives scrapy.utils.response.open_in_browser, the function whose ReDoS regression tests this pull request touches. It contains the process_time-based _assert_open_in_browser_is_fast helper and the two exploit-payload tests (test_open_in_browser_redos_comment, test_open_in_browser_redos_head) behind both the reported timing flakiness and the broken exploit input, plus the surrounding open_in_browser behaviour tests (test_inject_base_url with its doctype/comment/head-less cases, base-tag override, .txt extension and TypeError cases) that the same code path must keep satisfying.
